The equity does not re-rate on operating news because its price is governed by the parent-child structure, not by earnings — which is precisely why the exit has to be structured around the EVENT, not around the multiple.

rungs.anchor: ABOVE the best squeeze precedent (+26% = Y1,186) and ~0.90x book — fills only on a re-rate the event itself would not deliver

upside_trim_RESTING.why_the_rungs_sit_ABOVE_the_precedent_ba: This is the wrong-side test applied to an event name. A resting sell inside the Y1,063-1,186 precedent range would cap the payoff at less than a takeout and, worse, could fill into the announcement gap at a price the acquirer is about to beat. Placing both rungs above every precedent premium means a fill can only ever be a gift, never a leak.
upside_trim_RESTING.HARD_EVENT_CANCEL: If a TOB, squeeze-out, parent-stake transaction, or any Nissan-Nissan Shatai structural announcement prints: CANCEL BOTH RUNGS IMMEDIATELY and route to court. A live tender is adjudicated, never auto-filled at a stale limit. This condition overrides the §6 'keep resting through events' default and is the stated exception.
upside_trim_RESTING.cancel_below_reason: The parent-credit tail activating (court priced ~Y505/sh of unsecured exposure to junk-rated Nissan). Below Y780 this is a credit question, not a trim question.
